pages.title: Cherenkov Pillar
pages.text: A column of Cherenkov quartz that glows along its length with an even blue. Placed at a doorway it reads like a beam of light holding up the lintel. It is cool and faintly humming. Rows of them along a corridor make it feel like walking beneath a reactor pool.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Pillars of Cherenkov quartz gave the labs a sense of structure and a little light. They were easy to cut and look better than they have any right to.
